heading: Audeohost finds the venue. Audeohost has every event.
subhead: When it comes to Fan live TV sports promotion, Fanzo casts a wider net and is the leader in Out of Home sports-only discovery. Audeohost focusses on Venues and customer connection. We're highspeed rail when it comes to connection!  All events from Chess in the Garden, French dining Week, or TV sport in the bar.

beats.tag: Every event, every night — Audeohost's own turf
beats.title: Marketing up to 30 days out, not just today's discovery
beats.text: Trivia, live music, comedy, and every match on every screen — published up to a month ahead in the same Portal. Fanzo doesn't do that: its sport sport sport! Not always a good time, and not connected to your game. Fans always want their team - if they can't get that with you, they stay at home.

beats.tag: On matchday — where Fanzo hands off
beats.title: The build-up and the analysis, not just the 90 minutes
beats.text:
Fanzo can tell a fan which pub has the match; you can play a game within the game. But they don't control who hears what and often, most bars cannot do that either. 
Regardless of the pre-game environment, Audeohost gives you the studio commentary what is on TV is in your ear. 
During the game you have commentary, even if the bar is too load and you hear the half-time analysis and post game banter.

beats.tag: From then on — the leaderboard is ours to keep
beats.title: Connect once, stay top of the list
beats.text: A guest who favourites your venue on Audeohost sees it promoted first the next time they're deciding where to go. Fanzo, at best, gets someone through the door once. Audeohost is the source for every event at that venue, from that day forward.

beatStrip: Fanzo's the wider net on sport, today. Audeohost is the whole venue, a month out — and once a fan connects once, the leaderboard remains.
